title: StarterKit MITE
description: This mod lets the player get some supplies when they enter the world. You can also set the starting inventory for the player via json in the configs folder.
body:
## What is the content of this module ?

**A Torch**

MITE world is very dark at night, according to the torch provided by the Startkits , can be completely not afraid of darkness.
![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/654142a0c35f4ee4532d873a64715d7c30e165aa.png)

**The basic equipment**

With the basic equipment, you are not afraid of the monster with tools to kill the player, and the food provided by the mod can also prevent the player from living through the first night.![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6abc6e9f72aca37a93600cc28016589793d297fa.png)

**Portable weapons**

The daggers and bows provided by the  mod make it easy for players to quickly collect food.![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b952cc51f0be7c349129201600cc5662fc173c7f.png)
